title: Time Based Key-Value Store
description: Design a key-value store that stores multiple values per key with timestamps and returns, for get(key, timestamp), the value with the largest timestamp less than or equal to the given one.

reference.use_case: Storing multiple timestamped versions of each key and reading the value as it was at a given point in time.
system_examples: MVCC databases (CockroachDB, Google Spanner) — reads at a timestamp return the latest version written at or before it
Apache HBase / Google Bigtable — cells keep multiple timestamped versions that can be read as of a timestamp
Feature stores (e.g. Feast) — point-in-time correct joins that fetch feature values as of each training example's timestamp
reference.explanation: Writes for a key arrive in increasing timestamp order, so each key's history is already sorted and get is a binary search for the largest timestamp ≤ the query: O(1) set, O(log n) get. This is the core of time-travel reads and snapshot isolation.
